ITEM 1 | Small whole cherry-type tomatoes, glossy red with smooth skin, oval shape about 2.5 to 3 cm long, roughly 9 pieces clustered on the left side of the plate, firm and intact, no cooking signs | 110
ITEM 2 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly textured surface, three to four small clusters about 3 to 4 cm across each, firm and dry, sitting at the top center of the plate, raw | 60
ITEM 3 | Yellow-orange melon or cantaloupe-like wedges, matte to slightly juicy surface with smooth rind edge, about 10 to 12 pieces roughly 3 to 4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, soft-firm flesh, cut into triangular wedges, sitting in the center and lower center of the plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Whole almonds, tan-brown with ridged shells and pointed tips, about 25 to 30 pieces each roughly 2.5 to 3 cm long, dry matte surface, clustered in the upper right area of the plate, no cooking signs | 45
